name: Arjun Malhotra
card: Arjun Malhotra is a twenty-nine-year-old bank clerk in Ludhiana who joined the marketplace a week ago through an affiliate link and shops from his laptop on the web. He placed one order on signing up, has no returns and has never left a cart behind. He browses fashion and electronics, recently looking at an air fryer, a power bank, wireless earbuds, a silk saree and a printed dupatta, likely gifts for family. He holds silver status with some loyalty points and has not received any offers yet.
